verdicts.quote: If you’re developing a public app … you should build it using OAuth.
verdicts.reason: For a multi-tenant agent toolkit, the vendor directs public integrations to use OAuth rather than per-user API keys. ([developers.fathom.ai](https://developers.fathom.ai/oauth))

verdicts.quote: They are subject to review to ensure the best experience for all users.
verdicts.reason: While API keys exist, public OAuth apps (the likely path for Composio) require review, so access is app_review rather than self_serve_free. ([developers.fathom.ai](https://developers.fathom.ai/oauth))

verdicts.quote: List meetings … Get summary … Get transcript … List teams … List users … Create a webhook … Delete a webhook.
verdicts.reason: Docs cover core objects (meetings/recordings, teams/users, webhooks) with multiple endpoints—broader than “narrow,” short of “broad.” ([developers.fathom.ai](https://developers.fathom.ai/llms.txt))

verdicts.quote: Fathom now offers an official MCP … MCP server URL: https://api.fathom.ai/mcp
verdicts.reason: Vendor publishes and hosts its own MCP server and setup guides. ([developers.fathom.ai](https://developers.fathom.ai/mcp-docs))

verdicts.quote: Rate Limiting: users can make 60 calls per minute … we do not offer higher rate limits at this time.
verdicts.reason: API and docs are public and self‑serve, but rate limits (and OAuth app review for public integrations) add meaningful constraints. ([help.fathom.video](https://help.fathom.video/en/articles/8368641))
